about: The relay eval's ground truth (tests/eval/relay/reference.ts): Claude Opus 5.5's reading of each case, code-checked, then reviewed by hand. review: auto (as built), checked (read and right) or corrected (changed by hand; see notes). Rebuild with pnpm eval:relay --build-reference [--force].
